title: IncuBrix Timeline
description: The derived state of a video after all active edits. Always produced by replay(source, stack). Never stored or mutated directly.

source.description: Immutable metadata about the original source video.

sha256.description: SHA-256 hex digest of the original source file. Never changes.

duration_frames.description: Total duration of the source in integer frames.

fps.description: Frames per second (normalised constant FPS stored at intake).

has_audio.description: Whether the source has an audio track.

segments.description: Ordered list of source ranges to play, in output order. Defines the final edit.

src_in_f.description: First source frame (inclusive) of this segment.

src_out_f.description: First source frame after this segment (exclusive). src_out_f > src_in_f.

speed.description: Playback speed multiplier. 1.0 = normal, 2.0 = 2x fast, 0.5 = slow motion. Output length = max(1, round((src_out_f - src_in_f) / speed)) frames.

overlays.description: Caption/text overlays. Each is anchored to word IDs, never to output timestamps.

style.description: Style properties (color, size, font, position, etc.).

anchor.description: Word ID anchor. Display time is COMPUTED from alive anchor words — never stored here.

start_word_id.description: ID of the first anchor word (e.g. 'w0001').

end_word_id.description: ID of the last anchor word (inclusive).

status.description: active: all anchor words alive. dormant: all anchor words cut (revives on restore). partial: some anchor words cut.

original_word_count.description: Number of words in the anchor range at creation time. Used for partial-cut tracking.

effects.description: Audio effects (mute/bleep) anchored to word IDs.

type.description: mute: silence the audio. bleep: replace with a sine tone.

track.description: Filename or S3 key of the music track.

duck_db.description: Ducking level in dBFS when speech is detected (e.g. -12.0).

warnings.description: Human-readable warnings generated during replay (e.g. dormant caption, speed overlap). Excluded from timeline_hash.
